title: Johnson Controls energy savings contract Phase 3
summary: Members voted 9–0 on July 7 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, at up to $9,021,259 plus interest. The financing is a tax-exempt lease purchase with TD Equipment Finance Inc. for a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract, at 4.49 percent interest. A committee had recommended the resolution as amended on June 24, allowing the final amount to come in lower, and one speaker said they do not consent to the contract.
